title: Baked High-Protein Salmon Pasta
description: Salmon baked with cream cheese, cherry and sun-dried tomatoes, spinach and capers, then flaked through pasta.

source.name: Firsttakehadrian (Instagram)
source.note: Hype or Hoax, Episode 256, rated 9.2/10 (Worth the Hype). Original inspiration: @adamhoad_coaching.

confidence.note: Amounts and method from the creator's caption. Not yet cooked.

nutrition.note: As stated by the creator; fibre marked as his estimate.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Combine the salmon ({{salmon}}), cream cheese ({{cream-cheese}}), cherry tomatoes ({{cherry-tomatoes}}), spinach ({{spinach}}), sun-dried tomatoes ({{sundried}}) and capers ({{capers}}) in a large baking dish. Cover and bake for 40 minutes.

steps.title: Pasta
steps.text: Meanwhile, boil the pasta ({{pasta}}) until cooked and drain.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Flake the salmon, add the pasta to the dish and mix thoroughly.
